info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Grain Boundaries API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: task_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of Materials Project IDs to query on.

params.name: sigma_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of sigma

params.name: sigma_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of sigma

params.name: sigma
params.description: Value of sigma.

params.name: sigma_not_eq
params.description: Query for sigma being not equal to an exact value

params.name: sigma_eq_any
params.description: Query for sigma being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: sigma_neq_any
params.description: Query for sigma being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: rotation_angle_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of rotation_angle

params.name: rotation_angle_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of rotation_angle

params.name: gb_energy_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of gb_energy

params.name: gb_energy_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of gb_energy

params.name: w_sep_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of w_sep

params.name: w_sep_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of w_sep

params.name: type
params.description: Grain boundary type.

params.name: chemsys
params.description: Dash-delimited string of elements in the material.

params.name: pretty_formula
params.description: Formula of the material.

params.name: gb_plane
params.description: Miller index of the grain boundary plane as comma delimitd integers.

params.name: rotation_axis
params.description: Miller index of the rotation axis as comma delimitd integers.

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from GrainBoundaryDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `material_id` `sigma` `type` `rotation_axis` `gb_plane` `rotation_angle` `gb_energy` `initial_structure` `final_structure` `pretty_formula` `w_sep` `structure` `chemsys` `last_updated`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.
